verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents Bun's install, workspaces, catalogs, overrides/resolutions, audit, lockfile migration and pm subcommands. None of it shows a plugin system, third-party taps, overlays or pluggable backends for extending the package manager. Overrides/resolutions and trustedDependencies are related dependency controls, not extension mechanisms, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can extend the manager through third-party taps, overlays, plugins, or backends
